description: This file defines the Aws\IoTFleetWise\IoTFleetWiseClient class, which is a client class used to interact with the AWS IoT FleetWise service. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method annotations for various AWS IoT FleetWise operations, including creating, deleting, updating, and retrieving resources related to FleetWise.

classes.name: IoTFleetWiseClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS IoT FleetWise service, providing methods for managing vehicle fleets, campaigns, models, and other related resources.
